<thought>To obtain the precursors, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that generate a C‑C double bond (the key feature of the Doebner modification). Using the product cinnamic acid SMILES “O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1”, I will query for templates that form a “C-C double bonds” functional group. This should return candidate template IDs, from which I can select one and later apply it to get the precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
